fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Instance Group Manager
fields.help: The instance group manager this instance config is part of.

fields.label: Minimal Action
fields.help: The minimal action to perform on the instance during an update.

fields.label: Most Disruptive Allowed Action
fields.help: The most disruptive action to perform on the instance during an update.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name for this per-instance config and its corresponding instance.

fields.label: Remove Instance On Destroy
fields.help: When true, deleting this config will immediately remove the underlying instance.

fields.label: Remove Instance State On Destroy
fields.help: When true, deleting this config will immediately remove any specified state from the underlying instance.

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: Zone where the containing instance group manager is located

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: The mode of the disk.
